```{r}

```

```{r}

sqrt(var(y)) # sqrt of var = sd
sd(y) # same value as above func
```

## Plotting

```{r}
x <- rnorm(1000)
y <- rnorm(1000)
plot(x,y)
plot(x,y, xlab="this is the x-axis", ylab="this is the y-axis", main= "Plot of X vs Y")
```

```{r}
pdf('Figure1.pdf') # We open the pdf here
plot(x,y, col ='green') # Add one graph
x <- rnorm(1000)
y <- rnorm(1000)
plot(x,y) # and another
plot(x,y, xlab="this is the x-axis", ylab="this is the y-axis", main= "Plot of X vs Y") # and another
dev.off() # we close the pdf and save
```

```{r}
x <- seq(1, 10)
x
```

```{r}
x <- 9:90
x
```

```{r}
x <- seq(pi, -pi, length= 50)
x
```

```{r}
x <- y <- seq(-pi,pi)
f <- outer(x, y , function(x, y) cos(y) / ( 1 + x^2))
contour(x, y, f)
contour(x, y, f, nlevels = 45, add = T)
```

pretty cool looking right?

```{r}
fa <-(f - t(f)) / 2
contour(x, y, fa, nlevels= 15)
```

```{r}
image(x, y, fa) # heatmaps
```

```{r}
persp(x, y, fa)
```

```{r}
persp(x, y, fa, theta = 30) 
```

```{r}
persp(x, y, fa, theta = 50, phi = 35)
```

## Additional Graphical and Numerical Summaries

```{r}
plot(Auto$cylinders, Auto$mpg)
```

```{r}
cylinders <- as.factor(Auto$cylinders)
```

```{r}
plot(Auto$cylinders, Auto$mpg, col = 'red', xlab="cylinders", ylab="MPG")
```

```{r}
hist(Auto$mpg, col = 2, breaks = 15)
```

```{r}
pairs(Auto)
```

```{r}
pairs(~ mpg + displacement + horsepower + weight + acceleration, data = Auto)
```

```{r}
plot(Auto$horsepower, Auto$mpg)
identify(Auto$horsepower, Auto$mpg, Auto$name)
```

```{r}
summary(Auto)
```

```{r}
summary(Auto$mpg)
```
